newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chinese Estates up on special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Chinese Estates up on special dividend.

text.p: Shares of Chinese Estates Holdings Ltd were boosted on Tuesday by the company's proposed special interim dividend linked to its spin-off of Evergo China Holdings Ltd, brokers said.
"Distribution of the special dividend attracted buyers," said Edwin Cheung, senior manager at Taiwan Securities.
The shares jumped HK$0.35, or 4.96 percent, to hit a session high of HK$7.40 before steadying at HK$7.25 in late morning trade. Volume was 3.01 million shares.
Chinese Estates said on Monday it was proposing a spin-off of its China property business under a new company named Evergo China.
Chinese Estates said it would distribute to its shareholders 25 percent of the 1.2 billion Evergo China shares in the form of a special interim dividend.
Dividends will be paid in the proportion of 623 Evergo China shares for every 4,000 shares of Chinese Estates held.
